title: Summer jobs bounce back in UK thanks to busy calendar of sport and music

paragraphs.en: The summer job has staged a comeback this year thanks to the hot weather and a packed calendar of events such as the men’s football World Cup, new UK figures show.
paragraphs.zh: 新的英国数据显示，得益于炎热天气和男足世界杯等排得满满当当的活动日程，暑期工作今年卷土重来。

paragraphs.en: Recent months have seen a significant increase in seasonal hiring in sectors such as hospitality and tourism compared with summer 2025, said the Recruitment and Employment Confederation (REC), which runs a monthly labour market tracker.
paragraphs.zh: 运营月度劳动力市场追踪的招聘与就业联合会（Recruitment and Employment Confederation，REC）表示，与2025年夏季相比，近几个月酒店餐饮和旅游业等行业的季节性招聘显著增加。

paragraphs.en: It said that this time last year “there was concern about the death of the great British summer job”, but added: “This is the summer when the seasonal summer jobs market started to come back.
paragraphs.zh: 该联合会表示，去年此时“人们对英国暑期工作的消亡感到担忧”，但它补充道：“今年夏天，季节性暑期就业市场开始回暖。”

paragraphs.en: “Exceptionally warm weather and a busy calendar of sporting, music and cultural events … has helped boost demand for workers.”
paragraphs.zh: “异常温暖的天气，以及排得满满的体育、音乐和文化活动日程……帮助提振了对工人的需求。”

paragraphs.en: Related: Unemployed young people to join AI boot camps to get job-ready
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：失业年轻人将参加人工智能训练营，为就业做好准备

paragraphs.en: A dip in postings for summer jobs last year fuelled concerns that squeezed employers would continue to cut back on seasonal hiring, which has traditionally given young people their first experience of the world of work.
paragraphs.zh: 去年暑期工作招聘信息的减少，加剧了人们的担忧，即捉襟见肘的雇主将继续削减季节性招聘——而这一直是年轻人获得职场初体验的传统途径。

paragraphs.en: However, this year there has been a double-digit rise in hospitality and tourism job advertisements over the summer period.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，今年夏季期间，酒店餐饮和旅游业的招聘广告出现了两位数的增长。

paragraphs.en: But there was a slight dip in the number of active job postings and new job postings in July this year when compared with the previous month.
paragraphs.zh: 但与上月相比，今年7月在招岗位和新发布岗位的数量略有下降。
